title: Sterilization Process Modernization: Ethylene Oxide to Gamma Radiation for CS-100

workflowSteps.name: ECO Formulation & Draft Generation
workflowSteps.comments: Draft generated from ECO-2026-089 sterilization engineering change matrix.

workflowSteps.name: LabelTrace AI Autonomous Pre-Check
workflowSteps.comments: 12 affected labels analyzed. 2 Critical Blocking Issues identified (Missing JP Warning, UDI Barcode Mismatch). Staged fixes proposed.

workflowSteps.name: Global Regulatory Affairs Review
workflowSteps.comments: Reviewing PMDA MHLW Ordinance 169 warning placement and FDA 510(k) sterilization change assessment. Pending resolution of Japanese warning text.

workflowSteps.name: Quality Assurance & Compliance Signoff
workflowSteps.comments: Awaiting Regulatory signoff before barcode symbology verification and ISO 15223-1 check.

workflowSteps.name: Manufacturing & Packaging Operations
workflowSteps.owner: Kenji Sato (Lead Packaging Line Ops, Osaka)
workflowSteps.comments: Line tooling check for Tyvek heat seal temperature and gamma indicator sticker integration.

workflowSteps.name: Final Electronic DHF Release / BLOCKED Gate
workflowSteps.comments: Final gate: If any unresolved critical flags exist, state shifts to BLOCKED. When all signoffs complete, changes push to ERP/EUDAMED/GUDID as RELEASED.
